annotations.text:
ACC website — full redesign in the madeinmay.studio idiom.
An editorial studio look on ACC's own content, photography and wordmark. Light-only, one electric-blue accent used sparingly. Canvas display face is Bricolage Grotesque standing in for Clash Display (Fontshare, self-hosted in production). All motion sits behind prefers-reduced-motion.

Home — lean flow: hero (title + subtitle kept verbatim) -> welcome paragraph (kept verbatim) -> the 'ACC' wordmark dissolve -> six domains as peers -> Instagram (@acc_kengeri, build-time static grid) -> scripture close -> big footer. 'This week' and the weekly rhythm move to the Calendar page.
Mobile shown where layout diverges most — Home, Domains, and the Rosary reading mode (the make-or-break screen on a phone).

Visible [NEEDS ...] tags mark real content still owed by ACC — per-domain head contact, hours-per-week to join, who reads Contact messages, 2026 event dates, the founding story. Same honesty the live site already uses.
